security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Put your Docker app online on AWS without needing to know the cloud
bundle.longDescription: skyship takes a Docker project, builds it on your computer, sends it to AWS (Lightsail or EC2) and gives you back a public address. It explains each step and can remove everything when you are done.
